title: Bounded Agent Bridge Job Contract
purpose: Turn large marketplace work into small, independently testable jobs without granting agents open-ended authority.
hard_rules: A job is not revenue. Revenue requires an independent buyer, authorized external action, settled payment, fulfillment, delivery evidence, and reconciliation.
No job may exceed its declared budget, runtime, scope, or tool allowlist.
Retries must reuse the same idempotency key for the same logical action.
External publication, charges, third-party disclosure, GPU tenant execution, and DOOH booking require explicit authorization.
Unknown, missing, stale, simulated, and internal evidence never pass as verified.

transitions.gate: Inputs and measurable acceptance criteria exist.
Scope, budget, tools, risk tier, and approval policy pass.
Idempotency reservation succeeds and limits are enforced.
Output is schema-valid and tests have a recorded result.
Acceptance passes and a delivery receipt is emitted.

evaluator_rules: Reject output that does not validate against output_schema.
Reject claims without source URLs and retrieval timestamps where external facts are asserted.
Reject a pass if a required test is missing, skipped, or failed.
Reject any budget, scope, tool, or authorization violation.
A delivered job does not imply commercial success or payment.

decomposition_plan.task: Trace existing toll manifest to deployed route registry
decomposition_plan.gate: Every advertised route maps to a deployed handler or is marked held.

decomposition_plan.task: Probe the existing low-price route read-only
decomposition_plan.gate: Record status, latency, response schema, and timestamp; no charge.

decomposition_plan.task: Test settlement-to-entitlement idempotency using synthetic fixtures
decomposition_plan.gate: Duplicate events produce one entitlement; synthetic events never count as revenue.

decomposition_plan.task: Join existing offer, Stripe event, order, fulfillment, and delivery receipt fields
decomposition_plan.gate: Missing join keys remain explicit blockers.

decomposition_plan.task: Add usage receipt schema with per-tenant quota and replay protection
decomposition_plan.gate: Tenant, request ID, usage units, timestamp, and content digest are present.

decomposition_plan.task: Calculate contribution margin from measured usage and fees
decomposition_plan.gate: No toll advertised as purchasable unless the measured margin is positive.

decomposition_plan.task: Index reusable templates and stencils with licence, version, provenance, hash, and tests
decomposition_plan.gate: Unlicensed or provenance-missing assets cannot publish.

decomposition_plan.task: Specify opt-in GPU worker isolation and kill-switch acceptance tests
decomposition_plan.gate: No third-party job runs until isolation, metering, resource caps, and owner opt-in are proven.

decomposition_plan.task: Specify permissioned DOOH inventory and proof-of-play receipt
decomposition_plan.gate: No booking or spend; simulated inventory is labelled SIMULATED.

next_task: Complete ABJ-01 and ABJ-02 against the deployed gateway; keep all held routes non-purchasable until route parity and end-to-end settlement/fulfillment proof exist.
